Symptom: Test fails with "checking credentials: rejected" after a long wait
Check first: Extractor process still running? SAP router string correct?
Fix: Restart the extractor; correct the router string

Symptom: "Host not reachable" for an SAP system in a private cloud
Check first: Is the connection routed through an extractor in that network?
Fix: Allow-listing isn't enough; route it through an extractor in that network

Symptom: Extraction fails with "access denied" on a temporary file
Check first: Write access to the temporary folder

Symptom: Rows wider than 512 bytes can't be read
Changed connection arguments or new SAP Notes have no effect
Check first: When did the service last start?
Fix: Restart it: it reads settings only at start-up
